 385: #[derive(Debug)]
 386: pub struct WindowLayoutStore {
 387:     path: PathBuf,
 388:     snapshot: Mutex<Option<WindowLayoutSnapshot>>,
 389: }
 390: 
 391: impl WindowLayoutStore {
 392:     pub fn open(path: PathBuf) -> CoreResult<Self> {
 393:         let snapshot = match std::fs::File::open(&path) {
 394:             Ok(file) => {
 395:                 let mut bytes = Vec::new();
 396:                 file.take(MAX_WINDOW_LAYOUT_FILE_BYTES + 1)
 397:                     .read_to_end(&mut bytes)
 398:                     .map_err(|_| CoreError::storage())?;
 399:                 if bytes.len() as u64 > MAX_WINDOW_LAYOUT_FILE_BYTES {
 400:                     return Err(CoreError::new(
 401:                         "WINDOW_LAYOUT_FILE_TOO_LARGE",
 402:                         "BOOTSTRAP",
 403:                         false,
 404:                         "ウィンドウ配置の保存データが読込上限を超えています。",
 405:                     ));
 406:                 }
 407:                 let file: WindowLayoutFile = serde_json::from_slice(&bytes).map_err(|_| {
 408:                     CoreError::new(
 409:                         "WINDOW_LAYOUT_FILE_CORRUPT",
 410:                         "BOOTSTRAP",
 411:                         false,
 412:                         "ウィンドウ配置の保存データを安全に検証できません。",
 413:                     )
 414:                 })?;
 415:                 if file.version != WINDOW_LAYOUT_FILE_VERSION {
 416:                     return Err(CoreError::new(
 417:                         "WINDOW_LAYOUT_FILE_VERSION",
 418:                         "BOOTSTRAP",
 419:                         false,
 420:                         "ウィンドウ配置の保存データの版が対応外です。",
 421:                     ));
 422:                 }
 423:                 file.snapshot.validate()?;
 424:                 Some(file.snapshot)
 425:             }
 426:             Err(error) if error.kind() == std::io::ErrorKind::NotFound => None,
 427:             Err(_) => return Err(CoreError::storage()),
 428:         };
 429:         Ok(Self {
 430:             path,
 431:             snapshot: Mutex::new(snapshot),
 432:         })
 433:     }
 434: 
 435:     pub fn status(&self) -> WindowLayoutStatus {
 436:         let guard = self.snapshot.lock();
 437:         status_for_snapshot(guard.as_ref())
 438:     }
 439: 
 440:     pub fn current_snapshot_id(&self) -> CoreResult<Uuid> {
 441:         self.snapshot
 442:             .lock()
 443:             .as_ref()
 444:             .map(|snapshot| snapshot.snapshot_id)
 445:             .ok_or_else(|| {
 446:                 CoreError::invalid_request(
 447:                     "先に、現在開いているウィンドウの配置を明示的に保存してください。",
 448:                 )
 449:             })
 450:     }
 451: 
 452:     pub fn snapshot(&self, snapshot_id: Uuid) -> CoreResult<WindowLayoutSnapshot> {
 453:         self.snapshot
 454:             .lock()
 455:             .as_ref()
 456:             .filter(|snapshot| snapshot.snapshot_id == snapshot_id)
 457:             .cloned()
 458:             .ok_or_else(|| {
 459:                 CoreError::invalid_request(
 460:                     "保存済みの配置が更新されています。現在の配置を確認し直してください。",
 461:                 )
 462:             })
 463:     }
 464: 
 465:     pub fn replace(&self, snapshot: WindowLayoutSnapshot) -> CoreResult<WindowLayoutStatus> {
 466:         // The file and in-memory snapshot are one serialized state transition.
 467:         // Holding the same lock through serialization, durable replacement, and
 468:         // memory update prevents concurrent saves from diverging disk and memory.
 469:         let mut guard = self.snapshot.lock();
 470:         snapshot.validate()?;
 471:         let file = WindowLayoutFile {
 472:             version: WINDOW_LAYOUT_FILE_VERSION,
 473:             snapshot: snapshot.clone(),
 474:         };
 475:         let bytes = serde_json::to_vec_pretty(&file).map_err(|_| CoreError::storage())?;
 476:         if bytes.len() as u64 > MAX_WINDOW_LAYOUT_FILE_BYTES {
 477:             return Err(CoreError::invalid_request(
 478:                 "保存対象のウィンドウが配置データの上限を超えています。",
 479:             ));
 480:         }
 481:         replace_file_atomically(&self.path, &bytes)?;
 482:         *guard = Some(snapshot);
 483:         Ok(status_for_snapshot(guard.as_ref()))
 484:     }
 485: }
 486: 
 487: fn status_for_snapshot(snapshot: Option<&WindowLayoutSnapshot>) -> WindowLayoutStatus {
 488:     match snapshot {
 489:         Some(snapshot) => WindowLayoutStatus {
 490:             saved: true,
 491:             snapshot_id: Some(snapshot.snapshot_id),
 492:             saved_at_unix_ms: Some(snapshot.captured_at_unix_ms),
 493:             window_count: u32::try_from(snapshot.entries.len()).unwrap_or(u32::MAX),
 494:             excluded_game_windows: snapshot.excluded_game_windows,
 495:             skipped_windows: snapshot.skipped_windows,
 496:         },
 497:         None => WindowLayoutStatus {
 498:             saved: false,
 499:             snapshot_id: None,
 500:             saved_at_unix_ms: None,
 501:             window_count: 0,
 502:             excluded_game_windows: 0,
 503:             skipped_windows: 0,
 504:         },
 505:     }
 506: }
 507: 
 508: fn invalid_layout() -> CoreError {
 509:     CoreError::new(
 510:         "WINDOW_LAYOUT_INVALID",
 511:         "VALIDATE",
 512:         false,
 513:         "保存済みのウィンドウ配置を安全に検証できません。",
 514:     )
 515: }
 516: 
 517: fn replace_file_atomically(path: &Path, bytes: &[u8]) -> CoreResult<()> {
 518:     let file_name = path
 519:         .file_name()
 520:         .and_then(|value| value.to_str())
 521:         .unwrap_or("window-layout.json");
 522:     let temporary = path.with_file_name(format!("{file_name}.{}.tmp", Uuid::new_v4()));
 523:     std::fs::write(&temporary, bytes).map_err(|_| CoreError::storage())?;
 524:     if let Err(error) = replace_file(&temporary, path) {
 525:         let _ = std::fs::remove_file(&temporary);
 526:         return Err(error);
 527:     }
 528:     Ok(())
 529: }
 530: 
 531: #[cfg(windows)]
 532: fn replace_file(from: &Path, to: &Path) -> CoreResult<()> {
 533:     use windows::{
 534:         core::HSTRING,
 535:         Win32::Storage::FileSystem::{
 536:             MoveFileExW, MOVEFILE_REPLACE_EXISTING, MOVEFILE_WRITE_THROUGH,
 537:         },
 538:     };
 539: 
 540:     let from = HSTRING::from(from.as_os_str());
 541:     let to = HSTRING::from(to.as_os_str());
 542:     unsafe {
 543:         MoveFileExW(
 544:             &from,
 545:             &to,
 546:             MOVEFILE_REPLACE_EXISTING | MOVEFILE_WRITE_THROUGH,
 547:         )
 548:     }
 549:     .map_err(|_| CoreError::storage())
 550: }
 551: 
 552: #[cfg(not(windows))]
 553: fn replace_file(from: &Path, to: &Path) -> CoreResult<()> {
 554:     std::fs::rename(from, to).map_err(|_| CoreError::storage())
 555: }

 337:         if request.actions.is_empty() || request.actions.len() > MAX_ACTIONS_PER_TRANSACTION {
 338:             return Err(CoreError::invalid_request(
 339:                 "1回の適用には1件以上32件以下のActionを指定してください。",
 340:             ));
 341:         }
 342:         if self.journal.recovery_count()? > 0 {
 343:             return Err(CoreError::recovery_required(
 344:                 "未復元項目を解決するまで、新しい適用は開始できません。",
 345:             ));
 346:         }
 347:         let identity = self.identity_for_read()?;
 348:         let invocations = order_and_validate_requests(
 349:             request
 350:                 .actions
 351:                 .into_iter()
 352:                 .map(parse_action_request)
 353:                 .collect::<CoreResult<Vec<_>>>()?,
 354:         )?;
 355:         self.ensure_layout_invocations_current(&invocations)?;
 356:         let mut before = HashMap::with_capacity(invocations.len());
 357:         let mut changes = Vec::with_capacity(invocations.len());
 358:         let mut warnings = Vec::new();
 359:         for parameters in &invocations {
 360:             let action = registered_action(parameters.action_id())?;

 365:             let state = action
 366:                 .detect_current_state(&context, parameters)
 367:                 .map_err(CoreError::from)?;
 368:             let explanation = action
 369:                 .explain_changes(parameters)
 370:                 .map_err(CoreError::from)?;
 371:             if !action.metadata().auto_apply_eligible {
 372:                 warnings.push(if action.metadata().id == ActionId::SetupWindowLayout {
 373:                     "ウィンドウ配置の復元は、登録ゲームへの操作を避けるため明示操作だけで実行します。"
 374:                         .to_owned()

 376:                     format!(
 377:                         "{} は実機スモーク完了まで無人適用には使いません。",
 378:                         action.metadata().name
 379:                     )
 380:                 });
 381:             }
 382:             before.insert(parameters.action_id(), state_fingerprint(&state)?);
 383:             changes.push(preview_change(action.metadata(), &state, &explanation));
 384:         }

 402:             expires_at: format_timestamp(expires_at),

 381:     #[test]
 382:     fn unknown_parameter_fields_are_rejected() {
 383:         let json = r#"{
 384:             "action_id":"session.prevent_sleep",
 385:             "parameters":{"keep_display_on":false,"command":"calc.exe"}
 386:         }"#;
 387:         assert!(serde_json::from_str::<ActionParameters>(json).is_err());
 388:     }
 389: }
 426: pub fn parse_action_request(request: PreviewActionRequest) -> CoreResult<ActionParameters> {
 427:     let action_id = ActionId::from_str(&request.action_id)
 428:         .map_err(|_| CoreError::invalid_request("登録されていないAction IDは実行できません。"))?;
 429:     let mut parameters = request.parameters;
 430:     if let Some(value) = parameters.remove("keepDisplayOn") {
 431:         if parameters
 432:             .insert("keep_display_on".to_owned(), value)
 433:             .is_some()
 434:         {
 435:             return Err(CoreError::invalid_request(
 436:                 "同じパラメーターを重複して指定できません。",
 437:             ));
 438:         }
 439:     }
 440:     let tagged = serde_json::json!({
 441:         "action_id": action_id.as_str(),
 442:         "parameters": Value::Object(parameters),
 443:     });
 444:     serde_json::from_value(tagged)
 445:         .map_err(|_| CoreError::invalid_request("Actionの指定内容がschemaに一致しません。"))
 446: }
 447:

//! Fixed allowlist application discovery and direct launch.
//! No public function accepts a path, executable name, argument, or shell string.

use super::{registered_file_identity, WindowsError, WindowsErrorKind, WindowsResult};
use crate::action::{AppLaunchBundle, KnownAppObservation, KnownAppState, KnownAppsObservation};

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy)]
pub struct KnownApp {
    pub name: &'static str,
    app_path_name: &'static str,
    process_names: &'static [&'static str],
    system_fallback: bool,
    fixed_args: &'static [&'static str],
}

const EDGE: KnownApp = KnownApp {
    name: "Microsoft Edge",
    app_path_name: "msedge.exe",
    process_names: &["msedge.exe"],
    system_fallback: false,
    fixed_args: &[],
};
const NOTEPAD: KnownApp = KnownApp {
    name: "メモ帳",
    app_path_name: "notepad.exe",
    process_names: &["notepad.exe"],
    system_fallback: true,
    fixed_args: &[],
};
const CALCULATOR: KnownApp = KnownApp {
    name: "電卓",
    app_path_name: "calc.exe",
    process_names: &["calculatorapp.exe", "calc.exe"],
    system_fallback: true,
    fixed_args: &[],
};
const PAINT: KnownApp = KnownApp {
    name: "ペイント",
    app_path_name: "mspaint.exe",
    process_names: &["mspaint.exe"],
    system_fallback: true,
    fixed_args: &[],
};

const POWERTOYS: KnownApp = KnownApp {
    name: "Microsoft PowerToys",
    app_path_name: "PowerToys.exe",
    process_names: &["powertoys.exe"],
    system_fallback: false,
    fixed_args: &[],
};

const STUDY: &[KnownApp] = &[EDGE, NOTEPAD];
const WORK: &[KnownApp] = &[EDGE, NOTEPAD, CALCULATOR];
const CREATIVE: &[KnownApp] = &[PAINT, NOTEPAD];
const POWER_TOYS: &[KnownApp] = &[POWERTOYS];

pub const fn apps_for_bundle(bundle: AppLaunchBundle) -> &'static [KnownApp] {
    match bundle {
        AppLaunchBundle::Study => STUDY,
        AppLaunchBundle::Work => WORK,
        AppLaunchBundle::Creative => CREATIVE,
        AppLaunchBundle::PowerToys => POWER_TOYS,
    }
}

#[cfg(windows)]
fn app_path_registry_value(app: KnownApp) -> WindowsResult<Option<String>> {
    use winreg::{
        enums::{
            RegType, HKEY_CURRENT_USER, HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE, KEY_READ, KEY_WOW64_32KEY,
            KEY_WOW64_64KEY,
        },
        RegKey,
    };

    let subkey = format!(
        r"Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\App Paths\{}",
        app.app_path_name
    );
    let roots = [
        RegKey::predef(HKEY_CURRENT_USER),
        RegKey::predef(HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE),
    ];
    let views = [KEY_READ | KEY_WOW64_64KEY, KEY_READ | KEY_WOW64_32KEY];
    for root in roots {
        for view in views {
            let Ok(key) = root.open_subkey_with_flags(&subkey, view) else {
                continue;
            };
            let Ok(raw) = key.get_raw_value("") else {
                continue;
            };
            if raw.vtype != RegType::REG_SZ || raw.bytes.len() % 2 != 0 || raw.bytes.len() > 65_536
            {
                continue;
            }
            let units: Vec<u16> = raw
                .bytes
                .chunks_exact(2)
                .map(|pair| u16::from_le_bytes([pair[0], pair[1]]))
                .take_while(|value| *value != 0)
                .collect();
            let value = String::from_utf16(&units).map_err(|_| {
                WindowsError::new(
                    WindowsErrorKind::InvalidData,
                    "decode App Paths registry value",
                    None,
                )
            })?;
            if !value.is_empty() {
                return Ok(Some(value));
            }
        }
    }
    Ok(None)
}

/// Resolve the one fixed PowerToys App Paths entry. Absence is a normal
/// read-only result; malformed or inaccessible resolved files are errors.
#[cfg(windows)]
pub fn resolve_powertoys_app_path() -> WindowsResult<Option<String>> {
    let Some(candidate) = app_path_registry_value(POWERTOYS)? else {
        return Ok(None);
    };
    if candidate.contains('\0') || candidate.contains('"') {
        return Err(WindowsError::new(
            WindowsErrorKind::InvalidData,
            "reject malformed PowerToys App Paths value",
            None,
        ));
    }
    registered_file_identity(&candidate).map(|(canonical, _)| Some(canonical))
}

#[cfg(not(windows))]
pub fn resolve_powertoys_app_path() -> WindowsResult<Option<String>> {
    Err(WindowsError::unsupported(
        "resolve fixed PowerToys App Paths entry",
    ))
}

#[cfg(windows)]
fn windows_system_path(file_name: &'static str) -> WindowsResult<String> {
    use windows::Win32::System::SystemInformation::GetWindowsDirectoryW;
    let mut buffer = vec![0u16; 32_768];
    let length = unsafe { GetWindowsDirectoryW(Some(&mut buffer)) } as usize;
    if length == 0 || length >= buffer.len() {
        return Err(WindowsError::new(
            WindowsErrorKind::ApiFailure,
            "GetWindowsDirectoryW",
            None,
        ));
    }
    let windows = String::from_utf16(&buffer[..length]).map_err(|_| {
        WindowsError::new(
            WindowsErrorKind::InvalidData,
            "decode Windows directory",
            None,
        )
    })?;
    Ok(std::path::Path::new(&windows)
        .join("System32")
        .join(file_name)
        .to_string_lossy()
        .into_owned())
}

#[cfg(windows)]
pub fn resolve_known_app(app: KnownApp) -> WindowsResult<String> {
    let candidate = match app_path_registry_value(app)? {
        Some(value) => value,
        None if app.system_fallback => windows_system_path(app.app_path_name)?,
        None => {
            return Err(WindowsError::new(
                WindowsErrorKind::InvalidData,
                "known app is not registered in App Paths",
                None,
            ))
        }
    };
    if candidate.contains('\0') || candidate.contains('"') {
        return Err(WindowsError::new(
            WindowsErrorKind::InvalidData,
            "reject malformed App Paths value",
            None,
        ));
    }
    registered_file_identity(&candidate).map(|(canonical, _)| canonical)
}

#[cfg(not(windows))]
pub fn resolve_known_app(_app: KnownApp) -> WindowsResult<String> {
    Err(WindowsError::unsupported("resolve fixed App Paths entry"))
}

#[cfg(windows)]
fn running_process_names() -> WindowsResult<std::collections::HashSet<String>> {
    use windows::{
